## 简体中文

- 将“CN 前置分流”更名为“CN 路由分流”，只按真实目标 IP 配置系统路由，不参与 DNS 解析判断。启用后保留 FakeIP：真实大陆 IP 可走物理网卡，其他公网 IP 和 FakeIP 流量进入核心。
- 前置 DNS 继续按自定义域名、domains-min、默认策略的顺序决定 real IP / FakeIP；修复编辑自定义域名后 domains-min 热更新规则丢失的问题。
- CN 核心代理规则只处理 TUN 收到的真实 IP，避免境外域名的国内 CDN 地址覆盖 FakeIP 域名分流；保留无原生 IPv6 默认路由时的 FakeIP 接管。
- 补全核心出口快捷选择中的直连、可用节点、可路由端点和有效策略组，支持搜索并校验核心实际选择，明确区分前置直连与核心直连。
- 更新已有界面回归测试中的 CN 路由名称。beta.24 未完成 GitHub Release，本版本包含其全部分流修复。

## English

- Rename CN pre-routing to CN routing. Route real destination IPs without DNS IP classification and retain FakeIP: real mainland China IPs can use the physical uplink, while other public IPs and FakeIP traffic enter the core.
- Keep frontend DNS decisions ordered by custom domains, domains-min, then the default policy. Fix domains-min rules disappearing after custom-domain hot updates.
- Restrict the CN core proxy rule to real-IP TUN traffic so a foreign domain's domestic CDN address cannot override FakeIP domain routing. Preserve FakeIP capture without a native IPv6 default route.
- Complete searchable core-outbound choices with direct access, available nodes, routable endpoints, and valid policy groups. Verify the core's actual selection and distinguish frontend direct access from core direct access.
- Align existing UI regression expectations with CN routing labels. The beta.24 GitHub Release did not complete; this version includes all of its routing fixes.
